Let me create a summary document with my findings. ## Summary Report: Works Scatter Page Implementation - Hover Interaction & Video Display Based on thorough exploration of the codebase, here are my complete findings: --- ### 1. Directory Structure under `resource/ts/pages/works/` All subdirectories are present: - **`scene/`** - `works.scene.ts`: Scene configuration, constants, and factory functions - **`render/`** - `WorksSceneManager.ts`: Three.js scatter renderer with hover detection and video playback - **`runtime/`** - `WorksIntroRuntime.ts`, `WorksPageRuntime.ts`: Page lifecycle and grid/scatter UI management - **`theatre/`** - `WorksTheatreBridge.ts`, `WorksTheatreConfig.ts`, `WorksTheatreRuntime.ts`: Theatre.js animation authoring tools --- ### 2. Hover Detection Logic - Fully Traced **Location:** `/c/Users/edn_y/renew_nineonelabs/resource/ts/pages/works/render/WorksSceneManager.ts` The scatter view **has complete hover detection** using raycasting: - **Hit detection class** (`WorksHitRuntime`, lines 207-225): - Uses Three.js `Raycaster` to detect which mesh is under the pointer - Converts screen coordinates to normalized device coords and fires rays from camera - Returns the topmost intersected mesh from `interactiveMeshes` array - **Pointer events binding** (lines 829-955): - `pointermove` event: Resolves hovered mesh continuously (line 842-848) - Hover is **cleared when dragging** (line 851, 866) - Hover is **cleared on pointerleave** (line 914-917) - Pointer capture used for drag detection (line 894) - **Hover state management** (lines 514-515, 676-696): - `hovered` mesh stored and compared each frame - When `hovered` changes, previous hover video is deactivated (line 677) - Only hovered mesh gets 1.06x scale; others fade to 0.55 opacity (line 744, 750-751) --- ### 3. Video-Related Code in Works Scatter Flow **Video display is FULLY IMPLEMENTED in scatter view:** #### A.
